meta.name: manage-mounts
meta.description: Configure which host directories agent containers can access. View, add, or remove mount allowlist entries. Triggers on "mounts", "mount allowlist", "agent access to directories", "container mounts".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理容器可访问的主机目录挂载
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要控制 agent 容器能访问哪些主机目录
copy.tagline_en: Manage which host directories agent containers can access
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control which host directories agent containers can access

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能管理代理容器可访问的主机目录清单：查看当前允许的目录和读写权限，添加或删除目录，或重置为空。
howto.when: 当用户提到“mounts”、“mount allowlist”等关键词，或要求查看或修改代理可访问的目录时触发。

say.text: 显示当前的挂载允许列表
say.note: Claude 会展示允许的目录和权限。

say.text: 把 /home/me/data 设为 agent 可读写目录
say.note: Claude 会验证路径并写入配置。
Claude 会更新配置并移除该目录。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can manage the allowlist of host directories accessible to agent containers: view current entries with read/write flags, add or remove directories, or reset to empty.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions 'mounts', 'mount allowlist', or similar keywords, or asks to view/modify the accessible directories.

say_en.note: Claude displays the allowed directories and permissions.

say_en.text: Add /home/me/data as a read-write directory for agents.
say_en.note: Claude validates the path and updates the config.
Claude updates the config to remove that directory.
